interpretation: Paired median complete-run ratio is 1.0192, about 1.9% less elapsed time. The configured 10% material-improvement target remains unmet.
Delayed assertion paired ratio is 2.4014; interaction, navigation, setup and real-backend flows remain near parity.
Noop and expected-failure medians exceed the regression threshold; no workload breaches the observed-maximum threshold. The sampled memory policy passes.
The dedicated setup workload consumes about 45.7% of Flashwright complete time by median per-launch share. Broader application and preparation-policy experiments remain necessary.

attribution.interpretation: Flashwright sends 1048–1049 commands per complete instrumented launch versus 2189–2280 for Playwright. Fresh setup remains dominated by browser acknowledgements: Flashwright median target creation about 75–78ms, Page.enable about 55–56ms, and navigation about 41–44ms. Acknowledgement intervals include proxy/transport/scheduling and can overlap; these are not isolated browser CPU costs. Instrumented timings are excluded from performance comparisons.
